hypothesis: A strict host evaluator can reject empty, demo, stale, repeated, and presentation-only frame streams before native frame-provenance instrumentation is available; no one-second FPS snapshot can be promoted to a real-60 score.
scope: Read WORKER.md W01 and SUBAGENTS.md, the approved role prompt, SOURCE_MAP.md, current scripts/perf/summarize-run.py and relevant tests. Do not assume the existing CLI shape is a production scoring contract.

Create a new offline isolated Git worktree from the pinned application commit under the private W01-BUILD-001 output directory. Do not edit the original dirty worktree or initialize/update nested submodules; core source is read-only for this task.

Implement only a strict host-side evaluator and focused tests in scripts/perf. Accept versioned raw frame records with explicit process/session/surface/guest/render/present provenance, identity, phase, and timing. Missing or unsupported required evidence must yield INCONCLUSIVE or FAIL, never PASS. Preserve existing diagnostic median/min/max behavior only if clearly separated from production scoring; remove the no-argument demo fallback from any real-run path.

Test at least empty input, synthetic/demo records, presentation/vblank-only 60 Hz, 30 distinct game frames with 60 host presentations, duplicate polling, nonmonotonic or stale timestamps, session/surface reset, missing identity, gameplay exclusion, hidden long stall, and a valid synthetic fixture explicitly labeled as a test-only fixture. Do not claim a synthetic PASS is a device result.

Do not invent native IDs, actual FPS, energy, or device observations. Report fields not yet emitted by the exact core as unsupported; identify a minimal producer contract for a later task. No APK/core build, network, device command, installation, settings, save/load, or user data mutation.
Return a content-addressed patch, test/command log with exit codes, result.json and brief handoff. Independent Sol Max review is required before integration or use for scoring.
allowed_write_paths: new isolated private W01-BUILD-001 worktree: scripts/perf/summarize-run.py and focused scripts/perf tests/new evaluator only
read_only_evidence: original dirty application and core checkout
required_tests: focused evaluator unit tests and existing relevant scripts/perf tests with recorded exit codes
strict no-input run returns non-success and contains no demo samples
original dirty application/core diff hashes remain unchanged
